purpose: Canonical content, pose, placement, and publishing plan for chapter illustrations. Combine each subject brief with one art/library/styles/<style-id>/STYLE.md rendering brief to recreate every website image.
countPolicy: Start Here establishes a two-image minimum. Chapters near 1,200-1,900 words receive two images; chapters near 2,600-3,900 words receive three; the 4,900-word Shaping chapter receives four. Creature profile portraits are additional and do not replace its three rules-focused scenes.

mara-warrior.label: Mara, warrior
mara-warrior.brief: The established alert adult woman warrior: practical mail and worn brown leather armour, blue scarf, round shield, and sheathed sword.

corin-scout.label: Corin, scout and jack-of-all-trades
corin-scout.brief: Olive-skinned compact athletic adult man with dark curls, teal hooded short cloak, mustard-brown travel clothes, shortbow, dagger, belt tools, rope, and an alert approachable expression.

ilyra-shaper.label: Ilyra, Shaper
ilyra-shaper.brief: Tall older dark-skinned woman with silver-streaked braids, deep indigo travel robes, vermilion sash, copper charms, and a carved ash staff capped by an amber crystal.

fen-healer.label: Fen, dwarf healer-scholar
fen-healer.brief: Short broad nonbinary dwarf with copper-brown skin, cropped auburn hair and a short braided chin tuft, moss-green quilted field coat, medical-and-book satchel, notebook, herbs, bandages, and a compact tool hammer.

generationRecipe: Treat contentBrief, poseBrief, and cast as the only source of subject identity, equipment, action, staging, setting, lighting, and mood.
For the vivid master, use the named cast anchors plus the vivid style anchor as references. Preserve established faces, silhouettes, clothing, equipment, and color cues.

For alternate styles, use the vivid master as the composition/content reference and the selected style anchor as the rendering-only reference. Preserve scene geometry, cast identity, pose, action, and object count.
Do not inherit objects, composition, palette, lighting, weather, or mood from a style anchor.

Keep anatomy coherent, actions physically readable, the complete focal action safely framed, and backgrounds subordinate to the rule being illustrated. No text, logos, watermarks, borders, or panel divisions.

subjects.contentBrief: A small lived-in medieval village gathered around a well beside a winding lane and modest watchtower.
subjects.poseBrief: Elevated establishing view with the lane curling through the village and no dominant figure.
subjects.alt: A small lived-in medieval village gathers around a well beside a winding lane and modest watchtower.

subjects.contentBrief: At a ruined fort, a massive wooden door stands fully closed and fixed within its stone arch. Mara walks toward it with her shield carried normally and sword sheathed. Corin crouches beside the path, urgently raises an open hand to stop her, and points near—but does not touch—a concealed tripwire across her intended next step. Mara checks her stride and looks back toward his warning. Ilyra stands behind Corin and holds her amber staff-light low near the subtle clue. Cracked masonry and weeds establish consequences without showing dice.
subjects.poseBrief: Clear left-to-right narrative flow: Corin crouches low with one open palm raised toward Mara in an unmistakable stop gesture and his other hand indicating the ground. Mara halts naturally in mid-approach several steps from the closed door, separated from it by clear space; she does not touch, brace, lift, or carry it. Ilyra supports the warning from behind with her staff angled toward the clue. The hair-thin dark tripwire is mostly lost among cracks and weeds, with only one tiny amber glint. Gestures and eyelines reveal the trap without making it visually dominant.
subjects.alt: A crouching scout warns a warrior approaching a closed ruined gate and points out a concealed tripwire while a mage lights the path.

subjects.contentBrief: A complete full-body view of Mara in practical mail and worn leather armour with a sword sheathed and round shield on her back.
subjects.poseBrief: Natural alert noncombat stance, weight balanced, head turned toward an off-frame sound.
subjects.alt: A complete full-body view of an alert medieval woman warrior standing at ease with her sword sheathed and shield on her back.

subjects.contentBrief: The four recurring adventurers prepare beside a roadside milestone at dawn: Mara checks a shield strap, Corin tightens a rope coil and points along the road, Ilyra studies a compact map against her staff, and Fen repacks bandages and a notebook. Their gear and roles are distinct but practical.
subjects.poseBrief: Candid staggered group rather than a lineup: two standing, one half-crouched, one seated on the milestone, with overlapping gestures and varied heights. Nobody faces the viewer squarely.
subjects.alt: Four adventurers adjust a shield, rope, map, and medical satchel before setting out at dawn.

subjects.contentBrief: Corin leaps across a rain-dark chasm between broken mountain ledges while Mara anchors a safety rope around her waist on the near side. Loose stones fall into mist below; the far landing is reachable but uncertain.
subjects.poseBrief: Freeze the scout at the longest readable point of the jump with knees split, leading hand reaching, cloak and rope trailing in arcs. Warrior leans backward with a low wide stance, both hands controlling the rope.
subjects.alt: A scout leaps across a misty chasm while a warrior anchors his safety rope from the near ledge.

subjects.contentBrief: Corin lies on one elbow beside an ancient floor plate, using a thin pick and tiny mirror to expose a spring mechanism while Ilyra crouches behind him and holds a small steady light under her cloak. A locked bronze door waits beyond.
subjects.poseBrief: Low close three-quarter view: scout nearly prone with careful fingertips and one eye on the mirror; mage balanced on one knee, staff horizontal to shield the light. Emphasize precision, not danger spectacle.
subjects.alt: A scout carefully exposes an ancient floor trap while a crouching mage provides a steady covered light.

subjects.contentBrief: An in-world armourer's field-study arrangement showing exactly five clearly distinct protection systems on separate simple headless stands, ordered left to right: brown layered or boiled leather, padded ringmail with separate non-interlinked metal rings sewn flat onto the textile, overlapping metal scalemail, interlinked chainmail over a blue padded underlayer, and articulated platemail with chain backing visible at the joints. Include a few fit straps, buckles, and repair tools, but no labels or readable writing.
subjects.poseBrief: Three-quarter workshop tabletop composition with the five armour types ordered leather, ringmail, scalemail, chainmail, and platemail from left to right. Each suit remains fully readable without hiding its defining construction. Designed as an observational sketch, not a shop display.
subjects.alt: An armourer's field sketch compares leather, ringmail, scalemail, chainmail, and plate protection with straps and repair tools.

subjects.contentBrief: An in-world weapons master's field-study arrangement of a dagger, arming sword, axe, mace, spear, shortbow, heavy crossbow, quiver, and sling, all physically coherent and scaled relative to one another. The heavy crossbow has a narrow wooden tiller, symmetrical bow mounted perpendicular to it, one continuous uncrossed string caught at the central nut, a straight bolt groove, trigger lever, and a separate compact twin-handled windlass. Show wood grain, wrapped grips, and metal edges without labels or text.
subjects.poseBrief: Dynamic radial arrangement across a scarred worktable: spear forms a long diagonal, sword and bow cross beneath it, compact weapons cluster near the foreground, crossbow anchors one corner. No item is clipped or duplicated.
subjects.alt: A weapons master's field sketch compares blades, hafted weapons, a spear, bow, crossbow, sling, and ammunition.

subjects.contentBrief: Mara pivots inside a ruined hall and catches an orc's descending single-bit axe on the rim of her round shield while wielding exactly one fully unsheathed medieval arming sword in her free hand. Its complete straight blade remains visible, angled low and outward without striking; her hand closes firmly around the leather grip beneath a simple centered, perpendicular, bilaterally symmetrical crossguard. No scabbard is visible. The conventional asymmetric axe has one broad shield-facing blade, a compact eye/socket, no rear blade or hammer, and exactly one straight continuous wooden haft held naturally by both of the orc's hands. Chips and dust jump from the metal-on-metal impact; the orc remains a secondary opponent.
subjects.poseBrief: Oblique impact pose with warrior's shield high and torso twisted, rear foot sliding but planted. Her free hand wraps naturally around the sword's leather grip between pommel and guard; the exposed blade is straight, evenly tapered, fully visible, and directed low away from the shield impact. The axe's lower cutting edge visibly touches the shield rim at the debris burst; axe and shield form a strong crossing diagonal. The rigid unbent haft passes through the compact eye and continues through two naturally aligned, spaced grips; faces and hands remain clear. No static face-off, duplicate shaft, hammer-like head, malformed grip, visible scabbard, bent sword, or asymmetric guard.
subjects.alt: A warrior twists under an orc's axe and catches the blow on the raised rim of her round shield.

subjects.contentBrief: Corin kneels behind a broken waist-high wall and draws his shortbow through a narrow gap while Fen pulls a wounded companion lower behind substantial cover. Arrows strike the far stone rather than bodies.
subjects.poseBrief: Layered depth: scout in a compact kneeling draw with only bow, head, and shoulder exposed; dwarf healer low and side-on, dragging the companion by the harness. Clear wall silhouette explains cover.
subjects.alt: A kneeling scout aims through a broken wall while a dwarf healer pulls a wounded ally deeper into cover.

subjects.contentBrief: Fen uses a low center of gravity to reverse a much taller bandit's grapple in a muddy yard, turning beneath the bandit's right arm and levering the attacker off balance without striking. Fen uses a conventional two-on-one control: one separately sleeved hand grips the bandit's wrist while the other grips the same arm higher at mid-forearm near the elbow. A short stretch of naturally tapered forearm remains visible between the separated grips. The bandit's separate left arm reaches widely into empty space for balance, never touching or crossing behind Fen's neck or head.
subjects.poseBrief: Readable wrestling mechanics with exactly four arms and four hands: dwarf hips below the opponent's; shoulder tucked beneath the controlled arm; one dwarf hand at the sole wrist and the other clearly higher near the elbow, never stacked. The controlled arm has normal adult proportions: elbow-to-wrist distance slightly shorter than shoulder-to-elbow, a naturally tapering forearm, narrow wrist, and one compact hand. The opponent's free arm remains separate and isolated in empty space; attacker tipped diagonally with one foot leaving the mud. No second controlled wrist or hand, elongated forearm, oversized wrist, or neck contact. Avoid a punching, choking, neck-crank, or throwing pose.
subjects.alt: A sturdy dwarf turns beneath a taller bandit's arm and reverses a grapple in a muddy yard.

subjects.contentBrief: Inside a dim warehouse, Corin hangs one-handed from a roof beam and prepares to drop behind an unaware armored sentry, dagger still held safely back until the instant of the ambush. Crates and lantern light establish concealment.
subjects.poseBrief: Compressed hanging pose with knees tucked, cloak wrapped close, free hand holding the dagger reverse-grip near his own shoulder. Sentry below walks away and never looks up.
subjects.alt: A concealed scout hangs from a warehouse rafter above an unaware sentry, poised to drop behind him.

subjects.contentBrief: Behind an overturned cart after a battle, Fen kneels over Mara's bandaged side and works from an open field medical satchel while Mara remains conscious and holds pressure. The battlefield is distant and blurred; the procedure is urgent but not graphic.
subjects.poseBrief: Healer on both knees leaning precisely over the wound with sleeves rolled and tools ordered; warrior reclines against a wheel, one knee raised, jaw set, free hand steadying the bandage. No gore.
subjects.alt: A dwarf field surgeon treats a conscious wounded warrior from an open medical satchel behind an overturned cart.

subjects.contentBrief: At a shattered gatehouse, Mara stands on fallen masonry and calls a clear command to Corin and Ilyra as they surge past her toward the breach. Smoke and defenders remain secondary; the moment is coordination, not triumphal posing.
subjects.poseBrief: Warrior planted high with shield extended to indicate the route, mouth open mid-command; scout accelerates low beneath the shield line; mage strides the opposite diagonal with staff ready. Three distinct movement vectors converge forward.
subjects.alt: A warrior calls directions from fallen masonry as a scout and mage surge together through a breached gate.

subjects.contentBrief: Ilyra stands in a rain-soaked courtyard and conjures a controlled ribbon of bright fire between her open hand and amber-tipped staff. Steam curls from wet stones while the flame remains shaped and purposeful, not an explosion.
subjects.poseBrief: Wide grounded stance with staff planted diagonally, casting hand turning palm-up, shoulders counter-rotated. The fire coils in a single S-curve that frames rather than obscures her face and hands.
subjects.alt: An older mage shapes a controlled ribbon of fire between her open hand and staff in a rain-wet courtyard.

subjects.contentBrief: Ilyra braces a translucent amber ward across a narrow cavern as dragonfire washes around its curved surface; Mara crouches behind it with shield protecting Fen, who shields a satchel of remedies. Only part of the distant dragon's head is visible.
subjects.poseBrief: Mage at the front with both arms extended and staff across her body, leaning into the pressure; warrior in a protective crouch behind; dwarf tucked low. Flame splits into two streams around the readable barrier arc.
subjects.alt: A mage braces an amber ward against dragonfire while a warrior shelters a dwarf healer behind it.

subjects.contentBrief: At night in a ruined observatory, Ilyra conducts a careful floor-circle ritual while Fen reads from an open blank-looking folio, Corin places the final copper token, and Mara watches the stair with shield ready. Moonlight and modest violet-blue magic illuminate the stones.
subjects.poseBrief: Overhead-oblique composition around the circle: mage kneeling with staff across one radius, healer seated with book, scout reaching from a squat, warrior standing outward-facing. Each role and eyeline differs.
subjects.alt: Four adventurers perform a careful moonlit ritual in a ruined observatory while the warrior guards the stair.

subjects.contentBrief: In a torchlit corridor, Corin freezes as two visually identical doorways and two matching images of Ilyra appear ahead; the real mage stands partly behind him, deliberately weaving the illusion with two fingers. One duplicated edge subtly dissolves into ink-like motes.
subjects.poseBrief: Scout twists mid-step with one boot lifted and hands spread in uncertainty; real mage remains small but readable behind; false mage and door repeat the same pose and geometry ahead. Keep exactly one intentional duplicate.
subjects.alt: A scout hesitates before two identical magical doorways while the real mage quietly maintains the illusion behind him.

subjects.contentBrief: A rain-wet stone bridge crosses a black gorge toward a ruined hill-fort beneath broken mountain clouds.
subjects.poseBrief: Wide landscape with bridge as a strong leading diagonal into the distant fort.
subjects.alt: A rain-wet stone bridge crosses a black gorge toward a ruined hill-fort beneath broken mountain clouds.

subjects.contentBrief: On a crumbling cliff stair, Corin hangs below the ledge from a taut rope after a fall; Mara lies prone and grips his forearm while her shield and planted boots anchor her, and Ilyra wraps the rope around her staff as an improvised belay. Rock fragments drop into fog.
subjects.poseBrief: Vertical rescue tension: scout hanging with one boot searching for purchase, warrior stretched flat with one arm locked, mage crouched backward with staff horizontal. Hands, rope path, and weight transfer must be physically coherent.
subjects.alt: A warrior and mage strain together to haul a scout who hangs from a rope below a crumbling cliff stair.

subjects.contentBrief: A solitary stone watchtower stands above a stormy moonlit sea as rain sweeps across the cliff path.
subjects.poseBrief: Wide cliff scene with the tower offset against the moon and waves driving across the lower edge.
subjects.alt: A solitary stone watchtower stands above a stormy moonlit sea as rain sweeps across the cliff path.

subjects.contentBrief: On a windy ridge above two clashing armies, a weathered dwarf commander crouches over a weighted campaign map and changes the position of carved cavalry and infantry markers while Mara points out a breach in the real valley below and a mounted messenger waits.
subjects.poseBrief: Commander low over the map with one marker pinched mid-move; warrior kneeling on one knee and extending a gauntleted finger toward the valley; messenger and horse turned to depart. Armies are broad masses, not tiny detailed figures.
subjects.alt: A dwarf commander moves army markers on a ridge map while a warrior points to a breach in the battle below.

subjects.contentBrief: In a quiet archive, Ilyra suspends an old sword above a stone table with a restrained amber glow while Fen compares its pommel and scabbard to diagrams in a folio with no readable text; Mara watches from arm's length with one hand ready on the shield strap.
subjects.poseBrief: Sword floats horizontally as the compositional axis; mage's hands frame but do not touch it, dwarf leans in with magnifying lens, warrior stands back in a wary half-turn. No explosive magic.
subjects.alt: A mage and dwarf scholar examine a softly glowing old sword while a cautious warrior watches from a safe distance.

subjects.contentBrief: In a moonless forest, Corin raises a shaded lantern that reveals only roots and nearby trunks while Ilyra turns toward the faint translucent silhouette of a spirit that her Spirit Sense detects beyond the visible light. A nocturnal predator's reflective eyes appear farther in another direction.
subjects.poseBrief: Scout crouched and peering into the lantern cone; mage upright but turned away from the physical light toward the spirit; spirit and animal eyes occupy separate depth planes to distinguish different senses.
subjects.alt: A scout searches a moonless forest by shaded lantern while a mage senses a faint spirit beyond the visible light.

subjects.contentBrief: In an abandoned shrine, exhausted Mara kneels and presses both hands firmly against her own temples while concentrating through the anguish of an active possession. A translucent hostile spirit rises through and overlaps her upper back, shoulders, and head as a displaced spectral double, its ghostly arms spreading through empty air without solid contact. Ilyra confronts it from several steps away with her amber-tipped staff directed toward them. Mara's solid body and the separate incorporeal spirit remain clearly distinguishable.
subjects.poseBrief: Mara is the central low figure, bent slightly forward with both hands holding only the sides of her own head, eyes narrowed and jaw clenched in focused anguish. The spirit twists upward and backward from her silhouette with selectively broken, vaporous edges; neither Mara nor Ilyra touches or grasps it. Ilyra stands at a controlled distance with her staff held diagonally toward the possession. Opposed diagonals show an internal struggle rather than physical wrestling.
subjects.alt: A kneeling warrior clutches her head in anguish as a translucent hostile spirit rises through her and a mage confronts it from several steps away.

subjects.contentBrief: The four adventurers hold a narrow woodland causeway against a mixed threat: one large ogre advances in the center while two smaller goblins use the banks. The party responds by role—Mara blocks the ogre, Corin shifts to the flank, Ilyra prepares controlled magic, and Fen pulls a civilian clear.
subjects.poseBrief: Wide tactical staging with clear lanes and unequal threat sizes; warrior and ogre form the center, scout moves laterally, mage anchors the rear, healer retreats diagonally with civilian. Avoid a generic shoulder-to-shoulder lineup.
subjects.alt: Four adventurers respond by role as an ogre and two goblins press along a narrow woodland causeway.

subjects.contentBrief: Two medieval scribes at opposite sides of a broad desk pass an open bound rules codex between them while a second copy, loose folios, ink, quills, and a simple wax seal wait nearby. The pages show decorative lines only, never readable words.
subjects.poseBrief: One older scribe slides the open book forward with both hands while a younger scribe receives it and holds a quill above a blank copy. Their hands and the shared codex form the focal triangle.
subjects.alt: Two scribes pass an open rules codex across a desk prepared with a second copy, quills, ink, and a wax seal.

subjects.contentBrief: A quiet scriptorium table holds an orderly lineage of differently bound game manuscripts, each with a distinct blank spine device, connected by copied folios, bookmarks, quills, and small ownership seals. No readable title, author name, trademark, or logo appears.
subjects.poseBrief: Oblique still life that leads from an old weathered volume in the foreground through several later bindings to a fresh open manuscript at the back. Hands of two unseen scribes enter from opposite edges to copy and organize pages.
subjects.alt: A scriptorium table traces a lineage of differently bound manuscripts through copied folios, bookmarks, quills, and seals.
